findings.detail: The design identifies both selectors used by CodeQL03._load_pinned_helper, their exact continuation paths and SHAs, and the existing distinct graph roles. It requires an explicit route rather than accepting a path-only alias or weakening _graph_member.
findings.required_implementation: Keep the selector-to-role/path/SHA bindings exact and reject unknown, foreign, changed, duplicate, or reordered requests.
findings.title: Computed historical selectors and exact graph roles are explicitly enumerated

findings.detail: The design does not treat generated frames, direct _graph_member calls, or precomputed context dictionaries as production proof. It requires the actual CodeQL helper pair, both historical context constructors, the real parent-stage chain, and a downstream sentinel after enrichment.
findings.required_implementation: Preserve real helper/validator/factory bodies and prevent the sentinel from masking either historical context or late loader failure.
findings.title: Actual helper bodies and parent-chain regression are required

findings.detail: The static audit records 43 dynamic rows, 25 stage ordinary-lookup mismatches, an additional joern_historical_configuration route, and four finite common-engine computed-selector families. These are implementation acceptance conditions, not evidence that the current stage can run.
findings.required_implementation: Bind or explicitly prove scoped nonreachability for every listed route and computed family with exact caller, selector, path, SHA, role, and module identity before successor freeze.
findings.title: The implementation must close the audited route inventory

limitations: This is implementation-only design approval. It is not a source-commit approval, qualification approval, analyzer capability result, or launch approval.

The BF17 stop performed partial frozen validation before failing in historical enrichment; that partial work must remain evidence and must not be relabeled as a completed parent-stage replay or qualification proof.
A future successor requires independent source/closure/core review and a fresh invocation review after implementation and tests.
required_implementation_properties: Use an append-only successor with new source/plan/core/contract bindings; preserve BF17 source, ledger, historical helpers, manifests, reviews, and original clock unchanged.
Keep separate semantic roles for incoming_historical_replay_helper05/nested_014 and incoming_historical_previous_helper01/nested_015; do not collapse same-path graph objects or choose candidates[0].
Cover normal, exception, and second-entry restoration of factory/spec/module/loader/facade/global identities, including all six late loaders and eager objects.

Use exact source path/SHA and ownership checks for all computed/private-engine selectors; reject unknown labels, wrong roots, wrong kinds/tokens, mutated constants, foreign module/spec/factory objects, and stale sys.modules entries.
Do not use global sys.path/sys.modules aliases, permissive fallback, fabricated runtime contexts, or bypasses around frozen resource, source, historical, checker, configuration, or terminal guards.
Run the design-specified actual parent historical-enrichment regression and near-miss route tests before any qualification invocation.
